string.name: arc_busy
string.value: This recording is still being written. Stop recording or choose a completed segment.

string.name: arc_empty
string.value: The recording is empty and was not exported.

string.name: arc_export_failed
string.value: Export failed. Check that the recording is complete and the destination is writable.

string.name: arc_seek_failed
string.value: Cannot seek to this position right now.

string.name: arc_play_failed
string.value: Playback failed. The file may be incomplete or deleted. Refresh the list and try again.

string.name: pub_save_failed
string.value: Could not save. Check the settings and try again.

string.name: pub_invalid_selection
string.value: Edit this address before using it for streaming.

string.name: pub_delete_selected
string.value: This also clears the current selection. No other address will be selected.

string.name: pub_unavailable
string.value: Cannot access the address list. Go back and try again.

string.name: pub_name
string.value: Name (do not enter a stream key)

string.name: pub_address
string.value: rtmps://host/app, rtmp://host/app, or full streaming URL

string.name: pub_key
string.value: Stream key (leave blank for a full URL)

string.name: pub_privacy
string.value: RTMPS uses TLS (default port 443); RTMP is unencrypted. Addresses are stored in app preferences. Masking them on screen does not encrypt them.

string.name: pub_full_url
string.value: For query parameters, enter the full URL and leave the stream key blank.

string.name: pub_slash
string.value: Use a single slash between the address and stream key.

string.name: pub_key_path
string.value: Enter a nonempty stream key path.

string.name: pub_format
string.value: Use rtmps:// or rtmp:// followed by host[:port]/app/stream. Do not include a username or password.

string.name: pub_invalid_profile
string.value: Check the streaming profile and try again.

string.name: scan_copy_error
string.value: Could not copy the stream URL.

string.name: scan_discovery_empty
string.value: No cameras found. Check the Wi-Fi connection and camera discovery settings.

string.name: scan_discovery_failed
string.value: Network discovery failed. Check Wi-Fi and try again.

string.name: scan_discovery_hint
string.value: Search for cameras on the same Wi-Fi network. You can add a camera when it returns a stream URL.

string.name: scan_discovery_ready
string.value: Start a scan to find nearby cameras.

string.name: scan_no_stream
string.value: No usable stream URL. The camera may require sign-in; you can enter its stream URL manually.

string.name: scan_store_error
string.value: Could not access the secure camera list. Unlock the device and try again.

string.name: scan_too_long
string.value: The camera details exceed the secure record size. Shorten the name or URL.
